questions.title: "Why is prior firearm possession admissible under Rule 404(b)?"
questions.question_body: "I’m confused because my defense tried to exclude testimony showing D.F had seen him holding the rifle before the incident, arguing it was propensity proof violating R‑404(b). The court said it was intrinsic evidence supporting the possession charge following United States v Battle. Can someone explain how past sightings qualify as intrinsic rather than propensitical?”

questions.title: "Are immediate limiting instructions required for suspect police statements under R‑901(c)?"
questions.question_body: "Section B discusses how counsel wanted an immediate limitation instruction before admitting D.F.’s statements made to officers while C.F’s statements were admitted without adverse impact at close‑of‑trial citing Bennett/Charboneau precedent. Why isn’t such hindsight limitation mandatory during trial proceedings?”

questions.title: "Can police reports serve as impeachment witnesses without explicit authentication?"
questions.question_body: "In Section E the trial court let C.F.`e disclosures made to investigators remain intact yet refused defense men entering portions of those reports without foundation—Cumbie requires authentication even though the declarant testified on‐the‐record.” Can someone outline what rules dictate authentication necessity here?”
